**1. MCPay**

MCPay is an open-source infrastructure that adds on-chain payments to any MCP server using the x402 protocol. It allows MCP clients, such as ChatGPT, to make pay-per-call requests without relying on static subscriptions or API keys. This enables AI agents and applications to pay only for what they use, automatically and transparently. ([docs.mcpay.tech](https://docs.mcpay.tech/?utm_source=openai))

**2. Latch**

Latch is an open payment layer that brings x402 micropayments to any MCP server.
